headlines.summary: LOS ANGELES, July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hanmi Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: HAFC) (“Hanmi” or the “Company”), the parent company of Hanmi Bank (the “Bank”), today announced that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend on its common stock for the 2026 third quarter of $0.28 per share. The dividend will be paid on August 19, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on August 3, 2026.
